name.value: Valemount Pines Golf Course & RV Park

description.value: A wooded, family-oriented RV park and golf course 3 km from Valemount town, with grassy shaded tent sites beside Swift Creek and the McLennan River, filtered drinking water, and flush bathrooms; expect a commercial atmosphere but solid amenities.

raw_osm.name: Valemount Pines Golf Course & RV Park

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active campground and golf course near Valemount, BC, with tent sites (No Service), half service, and full service RV sites. The website explicitly mentions filtered drinking water, showers with hot water, WiFi, laundry (full service sites), a camp store with ice, and online reservation forms. The FAQ states the town of Valemount is 3 km away with all amenities. No specific hiker/biker sites, cyclist discounts, or bike-specific amenities are mentioned. The site footer shows © 2026 and a '2026 GOLF SEASON' banner, confirming it is currently operating.
concerns: OSM has no phone number; website consistently shows 250-566-2500
OSM has no address; website does not provide a street address either
Website name uses 'and R.V. Park' while OSM uses '& RV Park' — minor formatting difference only
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active campground with tent sites, showers, potable water, laundry, and a camp store, located 3 km from the town of Valemount. A practical overnight stop for touring cyclists on Highway 5 or the Yellowhead corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email contact: [email protected]. Bike rentals are mentioned as available in town, not on site. The website notes the park is open 24/7. Pets allowed on leash, max 2 per site.

wow_evidence: tent sites beside Swift Creek and the McLennan River, filtered drinking water, and flush bathrooms
